liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Deep Elem Blues** (3 reviews): Reviewer praises strong second-guitar work from the young Robert Weir; Reviewer hears the heaviest, most intense guitar work here, with syncopation and a driving backbeat [3][7][13]
- **Attics Of My Life** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds it gorgeous, emotional, with harmonies spot on; Reviewer calls it easily the best Attics ever played [10][13]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls this Morning Dew typical of the era, which counts as a plus; Reviewer finds the Dew really nice [3][4]
- **Walkin' The Dog** (1 review): Not the best version, since it lacks a walking tempo [6]

## Setlist highlights

- **Walkin' The Dog**: rare: 9 archived performances [15]

## The recordings

- **gd70-11-09.aud.hanno.7591.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 6 songs; 34 min; rated 2.87/5 by 15 [1]. Said about its sound: Described as an okay but muddy board tape, tenth generation, with some vintage 1970 Dead still coming through; Reviewer finds the sound quality extremely poor; Reviewer calls the sound wretched, even compared with other 1970 audience tapes [3][4][5][7][10][14]
- **gd1970-11-09.179391.aud.andref.flac2448**: audience recording; 1 songs; 5 min [2]

## Around the show

- Reviewer doubts the tape is from Action House on 11/9/70, suspecting no recording or setlist exists, same for 11/10/70 [11]
- The Brooklyn Rock Palace tape from a couple of days later is said to be more listenable [5]
- Recommends the 6/24 and 11/8 audience tapes, and most others, ahead of this one [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-11-09.aud.hanno.7591.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Uli Tuete and Hanno Bunjes; source: Audience [1]. Also: Low-generation audience tape, passed along via Hanno Bunjes with thanks to Uli Teute; Pitch was corrected upward by 3 percent [1]
- **gd1970-11-09.179391.aud.andref.flac2448**: taped by John Pape Collection; source: AUD (mono) > ? > mid-1970's reel via the John Pape tape collection. [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1970-11-09 Mon Action House, Island Park, NY](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1426038199323/grateful-dead-1970-11-09-mon-action) [16]
